card.name: Leading digit of a multi-digit number
card.fires_on: A single leading digit, usually 2, 4 or 9, that starts a multi-digit number such as a dose, date or percentage, with the remaining digits still to come.

modes.label: Dose amounts
modes.description: First digit of a dose in mg, such as 200, 400 or 450, in dosing text.

modes.label: Dates and counts
modes.description: First digit of a day, count or gauge in general text.

card.writes: It favors tens words like eighty, seventy and ninety, and suppresses the digits 1, 2 and 3 as the next token.
card.plain: It marks the first digit of a number like 200 or 450, when more digits are about to follow.
